entities.name: PMID:25081900
observations: UK multisite cross-sectional survey of 472 patients 3 months to 5 years after complete resection of stage I–III cutaneous melanoma; used SCNS-SF34 with melanoma module.

entities.name: Melanoma unmet needs prevalence
observations: In the UK survey, 123/472 (27%) reported at least one unmet supportive-care need, mostly low-level; common concerns were fear of recurrence (29%), future uncertainty (25%), recurrence-risk information (24%), and outcomes if melanoma spread (20%).

Higher unmet needs correlated with nodal disease and anxiety/depression; younger age (OR 2.23) and leaving school early (OR 4.85) were associated with higher total need scores, while better emotional (OR 0.89) and social well-being (OR 0.91) were associated with fewer needs. Sex and tumour thickness were not associated.
